name: M0100 - Passwords in the Wild
description: Intent: Monitor-tier visibility on plaintext credential material (passwords, API keys, tokens) in URLs and small inline documents across every channel — gives analysts cross-channel signal whenever an authentication-shaped artifact appears in transit. Exclusions: no list-based exclusion; scope is bounded by the credential-detection content rule plus the plaintext-document dataset (D0100); tune by refining your CI rule for credentials so legitimate dev/test traffic doesn't trigger.
